51:31.text: said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"

51:32.text: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn

51:33.text: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.

51:34.text: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn
(polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins)

51:35.text: So We brought out from therein the believers.

51:36.text: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one

51:37.text: And We have left there a sign
And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea
in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.

51:38.text: , when We sent him to Fir‘aun

51:39.text: along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."

51:40.text: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.

51:41.text: when We sent against them the barren wind;

51:42.text: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

51:43.text: , when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

51:44.text: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah
overtook them while they were looking.

51:45.text: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

51:46.text: before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fâsiqûn

51:47.text: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.

51:48.text: And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent Spreader

51:49.text: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember

51:50.text: (from His Torment to His Mercy - Islâmic Monotheism)
am a plain warner to you from Him.

51:51.text: [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]
am a plain warner to you from Him.
